title: Lien Charges for a Corrected Lien: Title & Registration Services Fee Basis
content:
When the state returns a Title & Registration Services packet for a lien information error, Kestrel corrects the lien data from the finance records and the buyer pays the lien charges for the corrected lien, which are the registration state's lien recording fee from the state fee schedule, booked as a lien recording fee entry and rounded half up to the cent.

## Lien recording fee by registration state (USD)

| AZ | TX | GA | FL | NC | OH | PA | CO |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 2.00 | 21.50 | 15.00 | 34.00 | 0.00 |

The state is the registration state shown on the title order.

## Worked examples (hypothetical orders)

1. An order registering in PA: the lien charges are 34.00, booked as a lien recording fee entry.
2. An order registering in NC: the lien charges are 21.50.
3. An order registering in FL: the lien charges are 2.00.
